Research in behavioral finance has tried to improve the psychological realism of the traditional model along three dimensions.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Barberis argues behavioral finance is not scattered: its center of gravity is three psychology-based frameworks -- extrapolative beliefs, overconfidence/disagreement, and gain-loss (prospect-theory) preferences -- each with a distinct natural application across prices and volume.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Three Frameworks of Behavioral Asset Pricing
